dct_description_sm: This dataset compiles geochemical parameters from measurements on 24 terrestrial samples that were collected during the Yukon Coast expeditions in spring and summer 2019. Terrestrial sediment samples were taken from the catchment of Kanivaliuraq lagoon – Ptarmigan Bay on the Yukon mainland coast. Samples originate from various depths of the active layer and underlying permafrost. Parameters measured include total organic carbon and nitrogen (TOC, TN), as well as stable carbon and nitrogen isotopes (δ13C-TOC, δ15N-TN).
dct_title_s: Geochemical parameters of terrestrial sediment samples at the Yukon coast, Canada
